preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of friends N and roads M must satisfy the given constraints.
The road number K must be within the range of available roads.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N and 1 <= C <= 10**9 for A, B, C in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect valid friends and have a valid length.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the distance from A and the maximum distance rounded to 5 decimal places.
The distance from A must not exceed the length of the Kth road.
